section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses limitations of the present study, which involved multiple studies (referred to as 'these studies') conducted in the U.S. with predominantly White participants who self-selected into the research. The study assessed positive body image using the BAS-2 measure and acknowledges limitations including sample generalizability, self-report bias, and the correlational design that prevents causal inferences about the relationship between body appreciation and other variables.
